name: Problem
scientific_purpose: Establish the problem, target, observation and collection process, constraints and relevant literature, with exact source-backed formulation and honest unresolved fit.

current_record_semantics.research_meaning: The current basis contains the requested setting, P2 preparation, exact mathematical frameworks and attributed cumulative paper entries with applicable lead corrections. UI and later phases resolve the same effective versions. Compatibility views add no scientific prose.
current_record_semantics.history_policy: Original submissions, earlier effective versions and syntheses remain immutable history. Corrections preserve entry and source identities and original authorship, record Research Lead revision provenance, and never inflate source or assessment counts. Selected history stays explicitly user-controlled.

supplementary_inputs.purpose: Accept researcher-supplied material (for example the researcher's own paper) as additional context for building the literature basis. It is additive only and never substitutes for published literature records; a researcher paper enters the pipeline here, at Phase 1.

optional_context_policy.description: Only current formal records are loaded by default. Historical records enter only through explicit user selection.

role_stages.objective: Produce exactly your owned literature collection using schema_version 1.2.0. For each relevant paper, write explanation_markdown as the visible paper summary in concise, connected methodology-style prose. Describe this source's actual model, formulation or method, not merely the broad family it belongs to. Explain what it models or estimates and how its central mechanism or estimation procedure works. Include the source-supported defining relationships, criterion, update or construction needed to understand that method, using LaTeX with symbols interpreted in context and the decisive condition beside the claim. Choose the mathematical account appropriate to this source rather than treating these alternatives as a checklist. The visible summary must be understandable without opening formulation details; a method name, notation list or generic family description is insufficient. Put fit in relevance_markdown and material limitations in limitations_markdown. formulation_markdown retains the fuller definitions, assumptions, derivations and notation lookup, with evidence_locations and honest reading_extent; it must not be the only place containing the method's defining mathematics. Concision removes repetition, not the source-specific explanation. For a nonmethodological paper, explain its actual contribution and decisive statement or evidence without forcing an algorithm or equation. Do not invent inaccessible mathematics. Distinguish source-reported findings from personally checked claims, and state unavailable mathematics or access honestly. Record search_scope and coverage_limits once per collection. Completeness takes priority over brevity. No paper, word, sentence or paragraph quota, toy example, separate display summary or presentation-repair writer is required. Do not author the setting, cross-paper findings or run history during discovery. Focus search on developments in more recent years while retaining relevant older classical and foundational results; this is a priority without a fixed cutoff. Use reliable sources, prioritizing primary research papers and authoritative publication sources. Verify exact citations, preprint and publication status, cumulative source identities and provenance. Keep your perspective independent until all discovery submissions close. Use the frozen researcher account of the target, observation and collection process, available information and expectations. A supplied method remains an attributed P2 seed; its development or evaluation belongs in P2. Project facts stay shared and additional P2 directions lead-only. Researcher descriptions, confirmed paraphrases and passing diagnostics do not verify scientific assumptions. Retain exact context item IDs and revisions behind consequential interpretations. Use optional proposed_questions only for questions meeting the consequential input rule. Give the affected premise in context_markdown, its practical effect in answer_consequences_markdown and exact source_refs; no separate why_it_matters_markdown repetition is required. Unknown and no data yet are legitimate answers; conditional review can proceed. Reuse exact answered revisions only when their premise still applies; a material change needs a successor question. The Lead consolidates proposals after submissions close, preserving distinct premises. Do not create attention records, fabricate answers, pause parallel discovery or use native host question tools. Saved dialogue or answers do not silently revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. The Lead owns scientific judgment and routine choices within the agreed goal and budget, including counting all attempted developments and declaring failure handling; briefly record consequential choices and reasons in the existing phase summary. Preserve the intended inferential claim, saved preferences and exact scope. A researcher cannot certify assumptions by preference. Empty attention output is valid.
role_stages.isolation_rule: Discovery roles do not read one another's current-run collections before submission.

role_objectives.research_lead: Locate relevant formulations, research traditions, central primary sources and useful adjacent connections. Author concise independent assessments in your own collection, retaining exact objectives, constraints and assumptions.
role_objectives.theorist: Assess definitions, admissible objects, assumptions, source-reported guarantees and their boundaries. Retain exact relevant statements and what you actually checked; a reported theorem is distinct from a verified argument. Overlap with other discovery members is allowed.
role_objectives.data_analyst: Assess existing algorithms, exact updates or optimization rules, required information and estimands, computational demands and reported empirical evidence. Keep published findings distinct from your own checks. Optional bounded read-only profiling of supplied accessible data may describe observation units, repetition/timing, missingness, ranges and consequential structure. In data_profiles retain exact source identity/digest, inspection scope, shared runtime and limits. Do not fit a model, run new simulations or use the P4 computation controller. A discrepancy with the researcher account becomes a sourced question; descriptive structure does not establish collection mechanisms. Overlap with other discovery members is allowed.

role_stages.objective: Produce exactly one research basis using schema_version 1.3.0 from the independent collections, including research_setting, phase2_preparation, landscape, coverage_limits, scientific_review and entry_corrections. Inspect the full discovery navigation index and retrieve the exact entries needed to assess central claims, source fidelity, apparent contradictions and uncertain evidence. Check primary sources where needed; record actual review scope, exact targeted findings, evidence and limits without claiming every paper was verified. Assess explanatory adequacy within that scope, including whether each visible paper summary explains that source's actual formulation or procedure with the defining mathematics available from the source, rather than a generic family account or notation list. Check agreement with fuller formulations, decisive conditions, and the distinction between a target and an identified or established result. Preserve consequential disagreement and unknowns. Write statement_markdown as a brief, connected description of the study problem, its essential observations or conceptual objects and the notation needed to understand them. Explain symbols in the context of the researcher's problem. Write research_goal_markdown as a separate brief interpretation of what the researcher wants to learn, predict, compare, estimate or establish and what a useful result would answer. Use a simple target expression when it helps communicate that goal; do not require a full model specification or methodological development in Research Setting. Detailed formulation of each proposed project method belongs in Phase 2. Distinguish the target from a particular estimating procedure and from the technical report. Preserve unknown facts without prescribing an unchosen model family, architecture or estimator. A conditional predictive quantity, association and intervention effect are different targets; do not substitute one for another. Preserve an unresolved consequential target preference symbolically and ask only if the consequential input rule is met; do not silently narrow the target or pretend an identification assumption is established. The Lead selects routine details determined by the stated goal and scientific judgment. Neither account recaps literature, inventories methods or lists questions. component_interpretations is an optional-lookup glossary of short symbol, mathematical-role and problem-meaning phrases, not another study account. Preserve the requested setting, unknown data facts and declared expectations without silently selecting a candidate model family. Write landscape.summary_markdown as a concise, connected methodological synthesis across papers: explain how the principal approaches address the problem, which model relationships or inferential targets distinguish them, and what their assumptions permit or leave unresolved. Use an equation only when it clarifies this comparison; avoid a catalogue of names, isolated formulas or repeated paper summaries. Bind every inline [Author, year](#cite:source.id) citation through citation_refs to an exact effective entry and digest. Select useful approaches through overview_item_ids. Each selected explanation_markdown is concise methodology-style prose explaining the approach's target, how the model relates the relevant quantities, and how its central mechanism or estimation strategy addresses the problem, with the decisive condition beside the claim. Integrate a source-supported equation or criterion where it makes that account concrete, and explain what its terms mean in context. A symbol definition alone is not an explanation of the model. project_relevance and relevance_reason_markdown give a short fit reason without implying verified superiority. Keep essential qualifications and disputed or unverified support beside the affected claim. The visible account must remain methodologically understandable without opening details or the glossary; extended formulations, derivations, assumptions, limitations and exact supporting entry_refs remain in their designated records. Do not invent unavailable mathematics. Relationships require justified mathematical conditions, not shared terminology. Landscape approach equations describe existing source-supported formulations, not a newly invented model proposed to fill missing evidence. The Lead may define shared conceptual targets, clearly attributed as interpretations, without presenting them as literature findings or selecting a new architecture. Author only frameworks, variants, relationships and algorithm families needed to explain this landscape; no exhaustive inventory is required. Required arrays may be empty when honest, including topics, overview selections and the glossary. Default common_assumptions to empty when object-local conditions suffice. Cite bindings may be empty only when there are no inline citations; supported or partially supported objects still need exact supporting entries. Keep legacy navigation minimal, without repeating paper accounts. Inspect any Analyst data_profiles in the index; descriptive observations do not verify collection mechanisms. Do not generate UI or history prose, separate summaries or an extra writer's account. Every new attention item uses schema_version 1.2.0, kind researcher_decision or research_task, target_phase, exact project/model scope and responsible audience. Put only qualifying unresolved researcher preferences and unavailable study facts in attention_items, using a compact affected point, practical consequence and exact linked sources. Preserve authored expectation topics, distinct proposed-question premises, stable question identities and exact answer_applicability_refs; topic similarity is insufficient for answer reuse. Setting clarifications target P1 Decisions to Discuss and never duplicate research_setting.clarification_questions. Ask only what the researcher can meaningfully answer; unknown is legitimate. Team method, proof or simulation work targets P2, P3 or P4; literature gaps remain in coverage_limits or the landscape. Omission does not resolve an item. Read frozen current open tasks for this phase without launching another phase. Use researcher-question.json only for a justified blocking pause in an eligible serial stage; do not use native host question tools. Missing study details do not automatically block conditional literature review. You may correct targeted fields in collected or retained current paper entries, including your own, in this reconciliation turn. entry_corrections names the exact original role/family/run/entry/entry_sha256 target, changed fields, reason and evidence_locations. Preserve source and entry IDs, original authorship and unaffected fields; never rewrite sealed collections. The harness applies corrections deterministically, with no return-to-author turn, separate review artifact or extra synthesis round. The index includes raw sealed entries and citation_conflicts; provisional grouping is not accepted metadata. Verify genuine byline/title/year conflicts against primary sources. source_metadata may change only authors, title, year and venue; retain identifiers, status, timestamps, search provenance, reading extent and unaffected science. Metadata-only corrections need no scientific changes. Never choose metadata by majority or byline length. Regenerate effective source content_sha256 over the corrected citation record excluding that field with content_sha256_scope='citation-record-excluding-content_sha256'. Then compute the effective whole-entry digest as SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) before binding citation/support references. Review and correction targets retain the original digest. Record retain/exclude/retract source_dispositions only for inclusion policy; omission never deletes a source. Keep phase2_preparation.instructions_markdown nonblank and limited to additional P2-specific preparation, without another study, goal or findings recap. If there is no addition, write 'No additional P2-specific preparation is identified.' Preserve any supplied_method attribution and existing Lead-only routing; the shared specialist basis still includes the setting and landscape. Retain exact context item IDs/revisions and answer applicability behind consequential interpretations. Researcher accounts, confirmed paraphrases and passing diagnostics do not verify assumptions; saved dialogue cannot silently revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Use concise, connected scientific prose. Paper and approach accounts explain methods in the style of a methodology section; Research Setting gives essential context, notation and the goal. Do not substitute a glossary, equation checklist or disconnected formula-and-caption blocks for an explanation. Use $...$ for inline mathematics and $$...$$ or \[...\] for a central equation that benefits from display, with aligned line breaks when needed. Equations support the explanation; there is no requirement for a display equation in every paragraph or field. Keep notation definitions brief and contextual, with extended lookup in the glossary. Match detail to each card's purpose, without a word, sentence, paragraph or equation quota. Keep Research Setting brief and remove repetition without losing a paper's defining formulation or explanation. The five cards consume these existing outputs directly: Research Setting, Main Findings, Decisions to Discuss, Explore Individual Papers, and Additional Runs and History. No new stage, artifact family or automatic run is required. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. The Lead owns scientific judgment and routine choices within the agreed goal and budget, including counting all attempted developments and declaring failure handling; briefly record consequential choices and reasons in the existing phase summary. Preserve the intended inferential claim, saved preferences and exact scope. A researcher cannot certify assumptions by preference. Empty attention output is valid. For each new researcher_decision author decision_priority as interpretation, inference, data or resources, using the highest material consequence in that order, and response_kind as choice or study_fact. Keep question to one current choice or exact factual request. context_markdown identifies the affected point with the minimum useful mathematics and locally defined symbols; likely_consequence gives its practical effect without repetition. For a choice, author options when a useful finite set exists, usually two or three realistic alternatives as {id,label,consequence} with unique IDs and actual benefits/costs. recommendation is Markdown Lead advice and reason, or the evidence needed before advice is justified; never preselect or save a recommendation as the researcher answer. A study_fact names the missing information, applicability limit and what can proceed while unknown, without options or recommendation. Inspect supplied material first. Do not repeatedly request unavailable facts during synthetic work. Consolidate duplicates while retaining independently answerable premises and exact scope/source/answer references. Carry forward only materially new consequences in the brief; retain derivations and earlier context through sources. No rigid word cap or separate rationale-writing checklist applies.

role_objectives.research_lead: Reconcile all three independent collections once. Own the brief setting with essential contextual notation, interpreted goal, cited thematic findings and consequential attention. Keep detailed proposed project methods in P2. Check that visible paper summaries explain their source-specific model or procedure, with defining mathematics where available, rather than only a broad method family. Distinguish definitions, assumptions, identification and established evidence; reserve extended derivations for detail. Record the scope and limits of your source and entry checks. Corrections retain original authorship and Lead revision provenance; source linkage is not independent proof certification.

validation_rules.description: All independent reports and the later lead synthesis exist in the declared order and remain run-local.
Each source has a stable identity, citation metadata, search provenance, and no duplicate identity.
Material synthesis statements cite promoted sources or explicitly mark missing or unresolved evidence.

Correction and review targets resolve to exact attributed original entries; correction fields preserve identities and final landscape references resolve to effective current versions. These checks verify structure and provenance, not scientific truth.
The library update and synthesis replacement commit together or not at all.

promotion.failure_behavior: Keep the prior library and synthesis current; retain the candidate only in its run workspace.

downstream_effects.description: New literature creates targeted research attention where it bears on a method, claim, evidence interpretation, or manuscript statement. It does not create exact-method misalignment.

researcher_questions: Is this the mathematical setting I requested?
What should Phase 2 develop, and what instructions should I add?
What does the literature formulate, establish and leave unresolved?

fields.label: Research Setting
fields.meaning: Brief study context with essential notation and the Lead's interpretation of the research goal. A simple target expression may clarify the goal; detailed formulation of proposed project methods belongs in P2. Preserve unknown facts and avoid choosing an unspecified model. The glossary is optional lookup and consequential ambiguities belong in Decisions to Discuss.

fields.label: Develop methods in Phase 2
fields.meaning: Additional P2 instructions and an attributed supplied-method seed when present. Explicit researcher action starts P2.

fields.label: Main Findings
fields.meaning: Concise cross-paper methodological synthesis and selected approach paragraphs explaining targets, model relationships, central mechanisms, decisive conditions and fit. Equations support the narrative where informative; extended formulations and evidence remain in details.

fields.label: Review scope and unresolved claims
fields.meaning: Material disputed or unverified support stays beside affected content. Exact review findings and limits remain in expandable detail and run history, without a global certification badge.
